section_summary.extract_value: This section provides background on the widespread negative impacts of loneliness, particularly noting its rise as a psychosocial health concern in contemporary societies like India. It highlights the need for a reliable scale to measure loneliness in the Indian context. The present study, consisting of two sequentially conducted studies, aimed to investigate the psychometric properties of the three-item loneliness scale (TILS) among Indians. The first study confirmed the TILS's three-item structure, and the second study established its adequate reliability and validity.
